{{Quote|Those born with an affinity to the Force were always brought back to Tython. From youngling to apprentice, from Journeyer to Ranger, and finally to Master, a Je'daii grew. Passing from one temple to another, seeking knowledge, seeking balance in the Force&mdash;their creed a message of peace.|Ketu|<ref name="DOTJ 1">[[Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm 1|''Dawn of the Jedi: Force Storm'' 1]]</ref>}}
[[File:Training_at_Stav.png|thumb|right|300px|Je'daii training at Stav Kesh.]]
'''Je'daii training''' was the action of teaching an apprentice the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] in the [[Je'daii Order]] on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]].<ref name="Into the Void">''[[Dawn of the Jedi: Into the Void]]''</ref> [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Species/Legends|beings]] were brought to [[Padawan Kesh]] from across the [[Tython system/Legends|Tython system]] and trained as [[Je'daii initiate]]s.<ref name="DOTJ 0">[[Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi 0|''Star Wars: Dawn of the Jedi'' 0]]</ref> If they passed the [[Padawan Trial]],<ref name="NoP">''[[Nexus of Power]]''</ref> the [[Youngling/Legends|youngling]]s advanced to the next stage of their training as the [[Padawan (Je'daii)|Padawan]] of a [[Je'daii Master]].<ref name="DOTJ 0" /> Once a Padawan's training was complete, normally when the Padawan was in their teens, they were made [[Je'daii Journeyer]]s and sent on their [[Great Journey]]: an odyssey across the surface of Tython to visit each of the nine [[Je'daii Temples]]. If the Journeyer survived, upon the successful completion of their Great Journey they were elevated to the rank of [[Je'daii Ranger]]. If a Je'daii Ranger had shown sufficient experience, wisdom, and understanding of the Force, they might be promoted to the rank of Je'daii Master, which was the highest rank a Je'daii could achieve other than a [[Je'daii Temple Master]].<ref name="Into the Void" />
